subject: Incident notification: request for SIG/CAIQ artifacts and retention clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearviewanalytics.com>, security@clearviewanalytics.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Incident notification: request for SIG/CAIQ artifacts and retention clarifications

Hi Sam / ClearView security team,

I wanted to let you know about a limited event we found during a routine infrastructure migration on Jan 4. During the migration a short-lived token used by an internal deployment automation job was unintentionally logged to an internal debug stream that was NOT publicly accessible. We ran a full triage, rotated impacted credentials immediately, and have no indications of unauthorized access or data exfiltration.

Because ClearView has an active SIG/CAIQ review and SOC 2 intake underway with us, we want to be transparent and share the artifacts you’ll need to close your assessment:
- A redacted Incident Response Plan snippet showing our detection + rotation steps (attached: ir_plan_redacted.pdf)
- Sample access logs (attached: s3_access_logs_sample.csv) for the window 2027-01-04 02:00 - 06:00 UTC
- A short timeline and remediation notes in the Drive bundle (link below)

Two asks from your side so we can complete the SIG/CAIQ mapping:
1) Can you confirm whether ClearView needs additional telemetry (e.g., a full K/V cache access dump) or if the provided S3 access log sample is sufficient for your control owner?
2) Please confirm your preferred retention window for these artifacts—ClearView’s legal team has asked about how long Redwood will retain incident artifacts for audit purposes. Our default is 90 days for redacted IR artifacts; we can extend on request.

I’ve CC’d Olga and Karthik from our compliance and controls team—Olga will help with the SIG mappings and Karthik can provide the log export format if you need a different schema.

Drive evidence bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_evidence_bundle
HubSpot record: https://redwood.app/hubspot/assoc/HD-45321

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearviewanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@clearviewanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident notification: request for SIG/CAIQ artifacts and retention clarifications

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and for the quick remediation. Appreciate the transparency. A couple quick clarifying questions: 

- For the SIG review we usually require a 30/90/365 retention mapping per artifact (what you keep for 30 / 90 / 365 days). Can you provide a one-line mapping for the IR plan, logs, and any forensic snapshots?
- Our security team requests that any raw telemetry that could contain PII be shared only under an NDA. Is there an existing NDA on file or do you want us to sign the DocuSign you linked? Procurements has been CC’d.

If you can share the short retention mapping and confirm the DocuSign route, we’ll queue this into our SOC 2 evidence tracker and get back with any follow-ups.

—Sam
Sam Taylor
Security Lead, ClearView Analytics
sam.taylor@clearviewanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearviewanalytics.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Procurements <procurements@clearviewanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident notification: request for SIG/CAIQ artifacts and retention clarifications

Hi Sam —

Thanks — quick answers inline: 
- Retention mapping (one-line):
  • IR plan (redacted PDF): retained 90 days (extended to 365 on request)
  • Redacted forensic snapshots: retained 90 days; full unredacted snapshots retained 30 days unless otherwise requested under NDA
  • Access logs (sample attached): retained 365 days for production tenant logs; incident export samples kept 90 days

- NDA / DocuSign: We don’t currently have a bespoke NDA signed between Redwood and ClearView for forensic artifacts. I’ve initiated a DocuSign for a narrow-scope evidence NDA — link: https://app.docusign.com/123456789/NDA-Redwood-CV. If procurement prefers to route via your standard MSA addendum, we can accommodate.

Olga — can you confirm whether the S3 access log CSV attachment is sufficient for the SIG control owners or if they asked for additional fields? Karthik — I’m including you for confirm on the CSV schema and a small JSON schema example if ClearView needs a different export.

We can commit to delivering the redacted IR plan and the log sample by EOD PT today and the fuller scoped artifacts (under NDA) within 3 business days.

Thanks,

--
Marissa
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearviewanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident notification: request for SIG/CAIQ artifacts and retention clarifications

Sam / Marissa —

Quick note on the logs: the attached CSV contains the minimal fields SIG owners typically ask for (timestamp, bucket, object_key, requester_ip, action, request_id). If you need headers such as x-redwood-requester-id or agent-version we can add them in the next export. For larger exports we can provide gzipped JSON-lines with a simple mapping: {ts, bucket, object, ip, actor_id, action, request_id}.

I’ll prepare the JSON schema sample and place it in the Drive folder within the hour. If ClearView wants the full unredacted snapshot under NDA please confirm and we’ll route through DocuSign / procurement.

—Karthik
Security Controls Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
